items.caseName: Federation of Medical and Sales Representatives Associations of India v. Union of India
items.headline: Centre told to set up panel on pharma freebies to doctors
items.text: Union to form a committee in 2 weeks to suggest rules curbing unethical drug marketing. Compliance due; listed 29 Jan 2027.

items.caseName: Ramkrushna Prahllad Dongardive v. State of Maharashtra
items.coram: Ujjal Bhuyan, Atul S. Chandurkar, JJ.
items.headline: Search lapses don't void a seizure, but weaken it
items.text: Breach of S.100 CrPC affects only the weight of seizure evidence. HC's reversal set aside; acquittal restored.

items.caseName: Modern Asset v. KNK Construction(s) Pvt. Ltd.
items.coram: J.B. Pardiwala, K. Vinod Chandran, JJ.
items.headline: After IBC plan, counterclaim works only as set-off
items.text: Arbitrator appointment upheld, but the counterclaim can only be set off up to the admitted claim; no fresh recovery.

items.caseName: Shubham Equipment Pvt. Ltd. v. Rothwell Water Company Ltd.
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI; Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: Sole arbitrator named in joint venture dispute
items.text: JV and MoU disputes go under their own clauses, not the Korea-seated one. Former CJ R.D. Dhanuka appointed.

items.caseName: Roonam Kaushik v. Union of India
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI; Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: NALSA to decide Lok Adalat members' pay plea
items.text: Plea by Permanent Lok Adalat members sent to NALSA as a representation, to be decided in 4 months.

items.caseName: Prakash Singh v. Union of India
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI; Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: Jharkhand DGP rule prima facie breaches Prakash Singh
items.text: Notice to DGP Tadasha Mishra; amicus to examine other States' DGP laws. Listed after a week.

items.caseName: P.C. Hary v. Guruvayoor Devaswom Managing Committee
items.coram: Aravind Kumar, Vipul M. Pancholi, JJ.
items.headline: Guruvayur Ekadasi pooja to be held as last year
items.text: Udayasthamana Pooja to be held on Ekadasi (21 Nov) as per past practice; appeal hearing expedited.

items.caseName: In re: Lack of Adequate and Systematic Treatment for SMA Patients
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI; Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: Centre asked to propose a corpus for SMA patients
items.text: Union and amicus to suggest a permanent fund, from CSR and grants, to help Spinal Muscular Atrophy patients.

items.headline: Verdict reserved on journalist's NSA detention
items.text: Judgment reserved on Satyam Verma's habeas plea; bench questioned the word 'Aandolanjeevi' in the grounds.

items.caseName: Dipinder Kaur v. Bar Council of Delhi & Ors.
items.headline: Fake caste certificate alone can't remove an advocate
items.text: Removal needs proof the fraud secured enrolment. BCI order set aside; advocate restored but reprimanded.

items.caseName: Vishal Sharma v. State NCT of Delhi
items.headline: Bail after 10 months; probe called 'sham paperwork'
items.text: Cyber-fraud accused bailed as the probe had stalled and co-accused were never traced.

items.caseName: Kangana Ranaut v. Meta Platforms & Ors.
items.headline: Summons in Kangana's suit on obscene AI content
items.text: Summons and notice on her injunction plea; counsel to name defendants for takedowns. Listed Feb 2027.

items.caseName: Vijay Sai Deverakonda v. Ashok Kumar/John Doe & Ors.
items.headline: Deverakonda's suit on AI fakes: summons issued
items.text: Summons and notice on the actor's suit over AI content and fake endorsements; interim order to follow.

items.headline: Parvesh Verma slap row: police report sought
items.text: Notice on AAP worker's plea for protection and a probe into the alleged assault. Listed 17 Nov.

items.caseName: Dr. Ravi Basalingappagowda Pati v. State of Karnataka
items.headline: No coercive steps against BJP leader in voter-deletion FIR
items.text: Interim protection till 13 Oct in FIR over bids to delete 198 Muslim voters in Belagavi during SIR.

items.caseName: Laxman Sangappa Savadi v. State of Karnataka
items.headline: 2018 assault case against Minister Savadi stayed
items.text: Proceedings stayed; trial court's S.319 CrPC summons after the complainant turned hostile looked unlawful.

items.caseName: Smt. Giribala Singh v. State of Madhya Pradesh
items.headline: Twisha Sharma case: bail plea amendment partly allowed
items.text: Amendment allowed only for the new S.108 BNS charge; CBI says dowry-death probe continues. Listed 14 Oct.

items.caseName: C. Joseph Vijay v. S. Dinesh
items.headline: Orders reserved on CM Vijay's bid to end poll petition
items.text: Court asked if hiding assets can be 'undue influence' before reserving orders on the CM's rejection plea.
